## Activity

During June 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 392 captures. This records the volume of imaging activity reported for the month. The completed captures form the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 392 captures, 17 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.3 per cent. Ungradable images could not be assessed through the usual grading process and were excluded from assessment of the image findings. The result provides the monthly measure of image quality for West Gate Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 92 referable results during June 2022. The median lag from capture to grading was 24 days. These figures provide the reported grading activity and turnaround measure for the month. Overall, the report records the number of captures completed, the proportion that could not be graded, the referable results identified, and the median time taken for grading.
